raw_text: Has anyone noticed the flood of anti-US defense partnership articles on Indian subreddits lately? Multiple posts pushing the same talking points about losing strategic autonomy, all linking to RT and Sputnik articles. Some accounts are clearly coordinated — created within days of each other, same posting patterns. Feels like a bot campaign targeting Indian defense communities.
